Northern Ontario Paternity Trip · Segment 1a of 13

Whitby → Tobermory

Hwy 10 N / Hwy 6 N via Owen Sound | ~4 hrs | ~310 km | 15 stops
The trip opens to the northwest rather than due north. Hwy 10 N and Hwy 6 N run up the narrowing limestone spine of the Bruce Peninsula, Georgian Bay on one side and Lake Huron on the other, to Tobermory at the tip — about 310 km and 4 hours of driving. This segment ends at the Chi-Cheemaun ferry terminal; the crossing to Manitoulin itself is Segment 1b.
⚠️ Hwy 6 construction. A resurfacing project in Northern Bruce is causing delays on Hwy 6 through the 2026 season. Build a real buffer into the drive to Tobermory — Segment 1b’s one-hour ferry check-in cutoff is unforgiving.
⚠️ Bruce Peninsula National Park permits. Grotto / Cyprus Lake parking requires a confirmed reservation June 19 – September 7, in four-hour slots, tied to a specific vehicle and non-transferable. Outside those dates it’s first-come with self-registration. Campers do not get parking included.

DETAIL MAP

Northern Ontario Paternity Trip · Segment 1b of 13

Tobermory → Little Current

MS Chi-Cheemaun ferry (Tobermory → South Baymouth) + Hwy 6 N | ~1 hr driving + ferry | ~70 km | 14 stops
At Tobermory, the MS Chi-Cheemaun carries the car across the mouth of Georgian Bay to South Baymouth — 1 hr 45 min to 2 hrs underway, more like 2 to 2½ hours door to door once check-in and unloading are counted. From South Baymouth, Manitoulin — the largest freshwater island in the world — unrolls for roughly 70 km of quiet farmland and shoreline to Little Current. The most logistically complex day of the trip, and the only one built around a booking that cannot be missed.
⚠️ CRITICAL: Check in at the ferry ticket booth at least 1 hour before sailing — miss it and the reservation is void. (See full booking rules below.)
⚠️ FERRY SETS THE CALENDAR. The Chi-Cheemaun booking fixes the trip’s departure date, not the other way around. Reservation required at least 4 hrs ahead; check-in closes ONE HOUR before sailing or the booking is void. No refund under 24 hrs. Morning sailings sell out ~2 weeks ahead in summer.
⚠️ CROSSING TIME. 1 hr 45 min on-peak (Jun 19 – Sep 7), 2 hrs off-peak. With check-in beforehand and unloading after, budget 3 to 3½ hrs door to door — not two.
⛽ NO CAR GASOLINE ABOARD. No jerry cans, no spare fuel containers, none. There is fuel on both sides and it buys us nothing. Camp stove propane IS carried and MUST be declared at booking and again at check-in. Call 1-800-265-3163 ahead with exact canister count and sizes and get it confirmed — a Dangerous Goods Shipping Document may be required and must be in hand on the day. Undeclared goods are refused at the gate.
⚠️ NO RETURN TO THE CAR. The vehicle deck is sealed once underway. Everything needed for 2–2½ hrs comes out before boarding: diapers, wipes, formula, food, water, carrier, warm layers, medication, documents, and the full dog kit. Onboard food counter closes ~45 min after departure.
⚠️ DOG — DECIDE BEFORE BOOKING. There is no indoor pet area. Two options only: leashed with us on the designated outside deck area for the full 2–2½ hrs, or alone in the car, unreachable, on an enclosed deck with no ventilation — a real heat risk. Plan on the open deck. Travellers report a maintained pet area with room to keep dogs apart, and crew who accommodate in bad weather if asked; confirm by phone. One adult stays with him throughout. In hot weather book a morning sailing.

Northern Ontario Paternity Trip · Segment 2 of 13

Little Current → Sault Ste. Marie

Hwy 6 N / Hwy 17 W | ~3 hrs 15 min | ~300 km | 8 stops
From Little Current, cross the swing bridge off Manitoulin and pick up Hwy 6 north to Espanola, then turn west on Hwy 17 along the North Channel of Lake Huron toward the Sault, gateway to Lake Superior and home to the famous Algoma Central Railway.
⚠️ ⛵ Little Current swing bridge — the only road link off Manitoulin. In summer it opens for boat traffic during the first 15 minutes of each daylight hour; aim to reach it in the second half of the hour, not the first.

Northern Ontario Paternity Trip · Segment 3 of 13

Sault Ste. Marie → Wawa

Hwy 17 N (Lake Superior coast) | ~2.5 hrs | ~235 km | 10 stops
One of the most dramatic drives in Ontario — the highway clings to the rugged north shore of Lake Superior through Lake Superior Provincial Park.
📵 📵 No cell coverage between Sault Ste. Marie and Wawa. Hilly terrain degrades radio reception too.
⛽ ⛽ Fill in Sault Ste. Marie. Last dependable fuel is Batchawana Bay (~75 km north); Pancake Bay is seasonal, and Montreal River Harbour is reported to close unpredictably — do not count on it. Expect roughly 2 hours between stations.
⚠️ ⚠️ Montreal River Hill is a long, steep grade — take it slow with a loaded vehicle.
